Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) using a 3HA-tagged SMC3 protein. While phosphorylation is listed as a variable modification in the search parameters, there is no evidence of a dedicated phospho-enrichment step (e.g., TiO2/IMAC), so mod_phospho is not selected as a primary modifier; however, the search parameters are PTM-aware.

scope: Immunoprecipitation followed by liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (IP LC–MS/MS) of SMC3-3HA confirmed the interaction of SMC1, SMC3, and RAD21
Supernatants were incubated with 25 μl of anti-HA Dynabeads (Thermo Fisher 88836) overnight with rotation at 4°C.
The beads were reduced with 100 mM dithiothreitol (Sigma D9779), alkylated with 55 mM iodoacetamide (Sigma I1149), and subjected to on-bead digestion using 1 μg of trypsin (Thermo Fisher 90059).

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The mass spectrometry analysis was performed on material affinity-purified using anti-HA Dynabeads to isolate the SMC3-3HA complex.
